What differentiates

Every supported gradient is checked against finite differences. An unsupported one raises an error instead of returning zero; a zero means the physics never reads that input.

{{ caps.provenance }}: tests/verification/test_gradient_matrix.py. Raises: test_gradient_matrix_raise_table.py.
